name: Enforcer Iii — unique coarse sculpt
notes:
Individual reference-oriented shape study (one_heavy_arm), 50 tons. Custom torso and head contours, split arms and lower legs, separate location-correct gun pods. DRAFT; not approved for likeness. No reused mech geometry.
Connectivity resculpt: lower arms are now supported by wide volume bearings; distant decorative plates removed, and CT missile cassette braced into chest rather than hung as isolated large pods.
Second bespoke silhouette pass: head height/wing sweep/heavy cannon mass and overall size revised from reference comparisons; draft only.
